{{Top|leg}}
A '''thermal-resist pack''' was used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] commandos.

==Characteristics==
Thermal resist packs were a type of armored carrying bag that was resistant to energy, and were used to carry dangerous items such as [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] so that they did not go off during firefights.

==History==
[[Squalls]] and [[Junkin]], the demolitions experts of the [[Endor strike team/Legends|Endor strike team]], stored their explosive charges within these packs during their mission to destroy the [[Endor shield generator bunker]].
